summary: The Playwright test compiles and runs correctly, using appropriate async/await and Playwright API usage. The test case ID is preserved in the test title. However, the selector [data-test="product-1"] may be considered weak or too specific to a single product, impacting reusability. The navigation validation uses a broad regex /product/ which may pass for URLs not specific enough to verify the correct product detail page, constituting weak assertion strength.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is hardcoded to a single product and may not be flexible for multiple products.
issues.recommendation: Use data-test attributes dynamically or more generalized selectors to improve reusability across products.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a generic regex /product/ which could match unintended URLs and does not strongly validate that the correct product detail page is shown.
issues.recommendation: Use a more specific URL pattern or additional assertions on the page content to ensure the correct product detail page is loaded.

recommendations: Improve selector strategies to avoid hardcoding product-specific identifiers.
Strengthen navigation validation with more specific URL patterns or additional content checks to confirm correct product detail rendering.
